items.title: UE companion plugin
items.detail: Stage 8, in phases: a plugin that can read a Blueprint, push a graph from this app, and show a live compile. Not in 1.11.0.

items.title: Mac signing
items.detail: The macOS download is unsigned. Notarizing it needs an Apple certificate Johno has not added.

items.title: Public community repo
items.detail: The Community tab can list packs from a GitHub repo, but that download is off until a public repo is chosen. Local .bbpack import works now.

items.title: Linux packages
items.detail: AppImage and deb are built next to the Windows installer. They are unsigned, the same way the Windows build is unsigned today.
